title: Nalögo language
description: Oceanic language spoken in Solomon Islands
extract: Nalögo is an Oceanic language spoken on the island of Nendö in the Solomon Islands. It used to be lumped together with Natügu under a single language called the "Santa Cruz language", but the two varieties were recognized to be two distinct languages in 2012.
